message: Hey there, I need to tell you something... my lower leaves have been feeling a bit off lately — they're turning yellow and I'm not feeling as perky as usual. I think I might be getting a little too much water! Could you check if my soil is still wet before giving me another drink? And maybe snip off those yellowed leaves so I can focus my energy on growing new ones. I know we'll figure this out together! 🌿
